name: Lund University
summary: Research university in Lund, near Malmö; five English bachelor's confirmed for 2027: Biomedicine, Economy and Society, Maths, Physics, Geography.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry, and IB English meets English 6. Subjects count at grade 4 (3 at HL Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

dates.label: January round opens (only if you already hold your IB Diploma)
January round closes (only if you already hold your IB Diploma)
April round opens (EU/EEA): the round for May 2027 IB candidates
April round: proof of EU/EEA citizenship (fee exemption) due
April round: final IB results due via the IB Result Service (recipient code UHR)
April round: reply to your offer or lose the place

programmes.name: Biomedicine
programmes.ib: Biology and Chemistry (grade 4 at SL, 3 at HL), and Maths AA SL at 4, or AA or AI HL at 3.

programmes.name: Economy and Society
programmes.ib: Maths at the level of Swedish Maths 3c: AA at grade 3, or AI at 4 (AI HL at 3).

programmes.name: Sciences, Mathematics
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL at 4, or AA or AI HL at 3.

programmes.name: Sciences, Physics
programmes.ib: Physics and Chemistry (grade 4 at SL, 3 at HL), and Maths AA SL at 4, or AA or AI HL at 3.

programmes.name: Sciences, Physical Geography and Ecosystem Science
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL at 4, or AA or AI HL at 3, plus two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics.

notes: Lund says its international bachelor's programmes open in both rounds, so a May 2027 IB candidate applies in the national round, 15 March to 15 April 2027.
In the national round 66% of places go on school grades and 34% on the Swedish aptitude test, so as an IB student you compete on your converted IB total.
International Business, Development Studies, Fine Arts and the two Malmö music programmes are on Lund's English list of ten, but their pages show no autumn 2027 intake yet.
